description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Making Regulation to prescribe a method of customs valuation of Motor Vehicles imported and classified within 05 HS headings of the Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System that shall be in force from 26.05.2016
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations under the Customs Ordinance prescribing methods for customs valuation of motor vehicles. It involves legal/regulatory matters including amendments to customs procedures, repeal of previous notifications, and establishment of new valuation methods - all characteristic of Legal/Regulatory gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a minister by name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to make regulations, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
